title: Hotel Story says a second breach, on 22 November, exposed guest reservation data
date_note: Daily Security says Hotel Story confirmed the leak on 23 November; the attack is dated 22 November by the same article.
geo_basis: country as stated by the Korean-language source; no city given
summary: Daily Security reports that Hotel Story confirmed on 23 November a second personal-data leak, after an attacker exploited a vulnerability in its own system on 22 November. Exposed reservation data includes guest name, contact details, reservation number and stay details. Hotel Story gave no count of affected customers, and says it has reported the incident to authorities.
plain: Korean hotel booking service Hotel Story says an attacker exploited a flaw in its system and guest reservation data leaked. It gave no number of affected people. An earlier breach was reported in October.
exec: A booking platform's second leak in weeks exposed guest reservation details; Hotel Story has not said how many customers are affected.
action: Hotel Story advises customers to be wary of WhatsApp messages about booking changes or extra-payment requests and to verify them through the booking site's or accommodation's official contact.

validation.note: Only Daily Security read; it relays Hotel Story's own confirmation. No second publisher or Hotel Story notice read.
